notes: The two articles before νοσσιάν and πτέρυγας are decided differently: ἑαυτῆς displaces the first, while nothing competes for the supplied *her* of the second (rules 20, 76).
ὃν τρόπον → *even as* is one noncompositional unit; splitting *even* onto ὅν and *as* onto τρόπον would assign words neither token separately licenses.
The italicized *gathereth* is added under rule 103, ἐπισυνάξαι being already spent on *gathered*; reading it as a discontinuous second realization under rule 15 remains defensible.
ἡ ἀποκτείνουσα takes rule 90 (one English word, the article's), while τοὺς ἀπεσταλμένους takes rule 32 (two words, so the article keeps only the pronoun).
